title: New Laser Zaps Mosquitoes in SlowMotion | National Geographic
summary: A short National Geographic piece showing a laser system that tracks and kills mosquitoes, filmed in slow motion, as part of anti-malaria efforts. It comes from Intellectual Ventures' 2010 work.
why: HN commenters bring it up as proof that laser mosquito defense is technically feasible, in threads about DIY pest-zapping projects.
